quest.5142421100000001.quest_desc: A Sophisticated Backpack is portable inventory for expeditions. Right-click in the air while holding it, put a few items inside and check they persist after closing. Stationary chests and barrels belong to Sophisticated Storage; Sophisticated Core provides shared functionality.

Side slots accept functional upgrades such as pickup, magnet, crafting or smelting. Raising the backpack’s own tier expands its storage capabilities, while a Stack Upgrade changes items per slot; these are different improvements.

Start with a useful function and configure its tab before adding others. The backpack and stationary storage branches can develop independently; the copper backpack is optional and is not required for the iron route.
quest.5142421100000001.title: Obtain 1 × Backpack
quest.5142421100000002.quest_desc: Have in your inventory 1 × Chest (sophisticatedstorage:chest). The items are not consumed by this task.
quest.5142421100000002.title: Obtain 1 × Chest
quest.5142421100000003.quest_desc: A Sophisticated Storage Barrel is a stationary container with slots for functional upgrades. Place it, open it with a normal right-click and assign it to a particular resource stream at the base.
Test ordinary storage before adding pickup or a Hopper Upgrade. The container does not extract from a neighbouring machine by itself; use a suitable upgrade, pipe or the machine’s own output.

quest.514242110000000B.quest_desc: The Gold to Diamond Tier Upgrade raises an existing gold storage block to diamond tier. In SOQM this capacity is tied to the Quantum Processor and control components, so diamonds alone do not unlock the recipe.

Obtain the kit for quest credit, then right-click a compatible gold container with it. This upgrades the storage tier rather than occupying a functional upgrade slot; check the retained contents afterward.

quest.514242110000000F.quest_desc: A Magnet Upgrade attracts available item drops to the backpack. Install it in a side slot, configure its filtering and test a few dropped items before an expedition.

The magnet adds no inventory capacity and can collect drops near your own or another player’s production line. Disable it where items are deliberately left in the world and keep spare backpack capacity.
quest.514242110000000F.title: Obtain 1 × Magnet Upgrade

quest.5142421100000011.quest_desc: Stack Upgrade Tier 1 increases the number of items that fit in one backpack slot. Install it in an upgrade slot and test the new limit with a bulk resource such as cobblestone.
It helps with many copies of the same item but does not create extra separate slots for assorted items. Remove excess contents before taking it out, so the stored stacks fit the lower limit again.
